lines.text: Despite the fact it's the dead of night,
I find myself unable to fall asleep, and so I go outside.
Once I step outside, I see Leona and Biscuit sitting together.
You two can't sleep either?

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Hey, Trainer.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: We just finished putting the animals to sleep,

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: so I was talking with Biscuit.
Mind if I join you?

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: Not at all, have a seat.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: You're always welcome.
I plop myself down between Leona and Biscuit.
What were you talking about?

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: About how Biscuit was afraid of me.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: Hehe, I can see where I'd be a bit intimidating,

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: what with me walking around with all those big animals and all.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: I also make it out like I'm not afraid of anything.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: At any rate,

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I don't feel nearly as scared after this trip.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: That's good to hear.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: There is something

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I'm curious about though.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: What's that?

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I wanted to ask earlier.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Ruby seems awfully happy being with her family,

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: so...

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: What if she doesn't want to go back to the shelter tomorrow?

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: What makes you think she won't want to go back?

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Ruby seems happy enough at the shelter,

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: but I've never seen her this happy.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: It'd be only natural for her to want to stay after reuniting with her family, don't you think?

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Not only is she back with her family, but she's got all these wide-open spaces to roam around in.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I wouldn't blame her for preferring this place over the shelter.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Even Timi was late for dinner, and he's usually joined with you at the hip.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: And then Gray...

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: It's just a thought, that's all.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: It's their first time in a place where they can run around freely, so they must be a bit excited.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I'm sure if you ask them to come back, they will.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: As they are all kind and gentle!

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: Yeah...

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: I think so too.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: So there's no need to worry.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: You have so much trust in them.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: It's the least I can do.
Leona gently strokes Timi, who is sleeping soundly beside her.
The three of us chat well into the late hours,
and at some point, I drift off to sleep.
The next day.
Urgh...
I wake up with the scorching morning sunlight in my eyes.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Zzzzzz...
Beside me, Biscuit is still sleeping.
I glance around me, still half-asleep.
The vast meadow is spread out before me, bereft of a single soul. It's an image straight out of a painting.
Wait a second, where is everyone?
As I frantically look around, the strange sense of unease I felt the night prior returns.
I can't see Leona or the animals.
In a panic, I search the surroundings for any trace of them,
only to find animal tracks on the ground.
Trying to calm my nerves, I follow the tracks.
*Huff, huff...*
After walking for who knows how long,
I eventually see Leona and the animals off in the distance.
I hurriedly approach them, filled with anxiety.
Leona!

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: Ah.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: Zoo Keeper...?
What were you doing here?

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: Er...

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: I didn't think you would wake up so early.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: You caught me.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: Hmmm...

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: I can't hide it now.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: I guess I have no choice.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: I was saying my final farewell to the animals.
What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: I'm going to release all of them.
What?!

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: I've been thinking about it a lot.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: The original idea behind taking these animals in and training them

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: was ostensibly to protect endangered species.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: But don't you find it strange?

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: Humans are desperately attempting to return to the surface,

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: and here we are taking animals from the surface who are living perfectly normal lives and forcing them underground.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: We've faced so much opposition because people consider them to be wild animals.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: Feral beasts that are a danger to everyone around them.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: But these animals under our care can't be called beasts.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: They're far too docile, and wouldn't harm a fly.
I look at the animals standing before me.
While they don't exude any sort of threatening aura,
I nevertheless do feel a sort of primal fear rise up in me due to their sheer size and prowess.
I understand immediately what Leona is getting at.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: So,

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: I've decided to let them all live freely, as they should.
Are you doing this because the shelter was closed?

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: If anything, the shelter being shut down

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: made me realize that these animals couldn't live a full life down in the Ark.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: So please,

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: don't try to persuade me or stop me.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: I've already made my decision.
I have no intention of stopping you.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: ...What?
I have no right or reason to stop you.
You know these animals better than anyone, and this is what you've chosen to do.
But are you absolutely certain letting them go free like this is the right decision?

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: ... Yes.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: It won't be a problem.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: If I want to see them, I can come here.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: I'm sure they'll be pleased to see me again.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: ... Since they're so kind and gentle.
Leona turns to face the animals,
and shouts to them.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: So that's it, everyone.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: You're going back.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: Back to the world where you were born and raised.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: Of course, some of you might have a hard time adjusting,

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: but I know that

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: all of you want to stay here.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: Ruby, your family is waiting here for you.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: To tear you away from them wouldn't be right.

lines.speaker: ruby
lines.text: *Screech*

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: Gray, you heard that wolf pack inside the forest.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: You deserve to go somewhere where you can meet your true family.

lines.speaker: gray
lines.text: Ahwoooo...
While all the animals stand hesitantly,
Timi slowly approaches Leona.

lines.speaker: timi
lines.text: ... Grrr.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: Timi.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: When I first met you, I could fit you in the palm of my hand.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: I used to be worried that you were so much gentler than the others,

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: but the truth is that you have the heart of a lion.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: So be strong, and do what you know is right.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: Be a leader for the others.
*Click*
Leona undoes the collar around Timi's neck,
*Thud*
and gently pushes Timi away from her.
Timi walks forward.
One step.
Then another.
The other animals start to move in line with Timi's steps,
slowly at first, and then faster.
Wow...
Some of them spring across the meadow.
Some soar through the sky.
It is an awe-inspiring sight to behold.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: Isn't it beautiful?

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: I know this is the right thing to do. They were meant to be on the surface.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: Enjoy your freedom, my friends.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: Live free.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: We should head back.
Don't you want to look at them a little longer?

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: If I keep looking, I might change my mind and chase after them.
Leona...

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: After that whole speech, I bet I sound pretty stupid right now, don't I?

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: I can't help it.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: I could keep myself together with the others...

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: but not Timi.
Last night, you pretended that you didn't sense Timi's late returning, right?

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: How could I not know?

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: Even if we're apart for just a moment, I feel so empty inside.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: Let's head back.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: Before I try and go stop him.
... Okay. You can follow me.

lines.speaker: leona_no
lines.text: ... Yeah.
Leona turns to follow me back to the campsite,
refusing to look back.
